def check_dict_case(dictionary):
    if not dictionary:
        return False
    
    lowercase = all(isinstance(k, str) and k.islower() for k in dictionary.keys())
    uppercase = all(isinstance(k, str) and k.isupper() for k in dictionary.keys())
    
    return lowercase or uppercase
